  PROBLEM: The credentials classification in `_observable_condition` accepts a step titled "Provide GH_PAT to the vendor" because it never rejects recipient or handoff wording. `_check_credentials` then returns `met` whenever a credential workflow succeeded in the last 7 days.
  WHY: The daily tick marks a human handoff as done and may close the tracker through `_close_tracker_when_done`. activation_verify passes model-produced step text into these entries, so this wording can reach the classifier. All three reviewers rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputed it as a defect: the plan's condition is narrower, and nothing in the activation_verify.sh step builder (lines 774-784) shows this pattern. It listed the issue only as hardening.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:824-844 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_check_credentials`, the `except (ApiError, ValueError): data = None` branch caches a failed workflow-runs read as `None`, which falls through to `return "not_met"` instead of `check_failed`.
  WHY: This contradicts the fail-closed contract in the module docstring and agents.d/10118-operator-step-daily-tick.md. It also logs an API or auth failure as `outcome=not_met`, which hides it from log analysis. Nothing gets ticked either way. Severity disagreement: gemini rated it MAJOR and glm rated it NIT, so the highest is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 listed it only as hardening.
- README.md:474 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `GITHUB_AI_PLAN_GRANT_WRITE_ENABLED` row has escaped pipes inside an inline code span (`outcome=staged\|absent\|refused`).
  WHY: gemini says the rendered docs keep the backslashes, so the text does not match the real scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh log lines (NIT). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash disputed it: GFM requires `\|` inside code spans in tables, and the row is base content.

  PROBLEM: A failed workflow-runs read ends in `not_met`, not `check_failed`, which contradicts the docstring and agents.d/10118-operator-step-daily-tick.md. The `outcome=not_met` log line hides API or auth failures.
  WHY: Behaviour is safe because nothing is ticked. Suggested fix: cache an "error" sentinel and return "check_failed", and update the `([CREDENTIAL_STEP], {}, "not_met")` test (about 5 lines).
- HARDENING scripts/operator_step_issue.py `_observable_condition`, the `credentials` branch
  PROBLEM: Recipient or target wording ("to the vendor", "in every consumer repo") does not stop a step from being classed as `credentials`.
  WHY: The check only reads this repository's runs. Suggested fix: add a recipient/target regex rejection (about 3 lines).
- NOTE: It dropped the pass-1 README.md:474 escaped-pipe finding and the README append-only TASK_GAP as base content (README hunk index 49ca2ec..559be30; the PR's only README change is the README.md:3126 row). It downgraded the credential "Provide GH_PAT to the vendor" finding to hardening (plan docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:344; activation_verify.sh lines 774-784). === FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:727, 762-822, 824-844, 913-916 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: CREDENTIAL_TITLE_RE (`^(?:set|add|configure|provide|create)\b`) plus CREDENTIAL_NAME_RE classify "Provide GH_PAT to the vendor." as `credentials`. HUMAN_ACTION_RE does not match, and the HUMAN_OBJECT_TITLE_RE loop (lines 913-916) rejects only human-object words, so "vendor" passes.
  WHY: Any successful `review_autofix.yml`/`internal-review.yml`/`security-audit.yml` run in the last 7 days makes `_check_credentials` return "met". The handoff is then ticked (`reason=credentials`) and the tracker may close. This evades the docstring guard at lines 764-768.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:824-844 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_check_credentials` caches a failed read as `None` and falls through to `return "not_met"` (line 844). Sibling checks fail closed: `_check_allow_auto_merge`, and `_check_stable_release` at line 859.
  WHY: This contradicts "Every check fails closed (`check_failed`)" (docstring, around line 70) and the agents.d/10118 fragment. `OPERATOR_STEP_TICK ... outcome=not_met` mislabels API or auth failures. Nothing is ticked, so behaviour is safe.
- NOTE: It dropped the README.md:474 escaped-pipe NIT and the pass-1 TASK_GAP (README.md:471 in-place edit) as base drift. The PR diff has a single README hunk at line 3123, and the base text matches `agents.d/9920-github-ai-plan-grant-write.md:10` and `scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:534-546`. It also confirmed that all Phase 9 deliverables are present. Its hardening suggestions (recipient regex, `"error"` sentinel) mirror the two findings above (2 related items). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3.
